name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Boxwood goes with none of Anatoly, Sicilian, or Pin.

Boris, Caro-Kann, and Boxwood belong to different players.
Either Anatoly goes with Marble or Zwischenzug goes with Anatoly.
